First prototype used a synthetic SID and Write-Restricted Token for file write boundaries.
Network access was only advisory via environment variables due to firewall needing admin rights.
Final solution creates two local users (CodexSandboxOffline/Online) and uses elevated setup for firewall rules.
Subprocesses run under sandbox user identity with restricted SIDs.
